# no-empty-links

- ID: `MD042`
- Category: Links and images
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: no
- Tags: `links`

Inline links have a destination, and no link points at just \#.

## Why

An empty link looks clickable but leads nowhere.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

There is no automatic fix. Only the author knows where the link should go.

## Configure

Under `rules`, `no-empty-links: false` turns the rule off and
`no-empty-links: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-empty-links` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-empty-links -->
```
